messages.subject: Categorical variables
parts:

I am fitting a temporal model using a categorical variables one has three categories and other is a binary variable. I need to fit an INLA model to find the effect of each categorical variable for species counts. How can I fit an INLA model for this?

Thanks in advance.

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Categorical variables
parts:
so you want one intercept for each level?

z = as.factor(1:3)

then

y ~ -1 + z + f(....)

?

this will give you one intercept for each level of the factor z.

parts:
Y ~ -1 + x + ...

And 

Y ~ 0 + x + ...

Are the same, as both remove the default intercept.
